name: InfoCard
description: A compact data-display card that shows a title, a bold value, and an optional icon inside a colored circular badge. The icon color can be themed to primary, green, yellow, red, or gray. Built on top of the Card and CardContent components.

props.name: title
props.description: Small descriptive label displayed above the value (e.g. "Total Users").

props.name: value
props.description: The primary metric or data point displayed in bold (e.g. "1,234").

props.name: icon
props.description: A React node (typically a Lucide icon) displayed inside a colored circular badge on desktop and inline on mobile.

props.name: iconColor
props.description: Determines the background and text color of the icon badge. Falls back to primary when not specified.

accessibility.role: Inherits from Card component (typically rendered as a div).
accessibility.aria: No explicit ARIA attributes. The title and value are conveyed through visible text content.
accessibility.notes: On small screens the circular icon badge is hidden and a plain colored icon is shown instead for a compact layout.
